notes.title: Pre-Odyssey 1.1
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone![/p][p]We’ve just pushed out a small but handy update for [i]Pre-Odyssey: Love at First Quack[/i] 🦆✨[/p][p][b]Patch Notes:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Quality of Life:[/b] The unlockable walkthrough now shows which endings you’ve already unlocked; making it easier to keep track of your progress.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Correction:[/b] Fixed a small error in the walkthrough to ensure everything is accurate (correction for Ending 1B walkthrough)[/p][/*][*][p]Ending credits can now be skipped if you've seen it once, but you have to use the skip function[/p][/*][/list][p]Changes will show up once an ending is obtained, so it’s best to unlock everything again for the new features to apply![/p][p]
[/p][p]We hope this makes your journey through Odysseus’ world even smoother.
Thank you so much for all your support and feedback so far. it’s been incredible seeing your reactions! 💖[/p][p][/p][p]If you’re enjoying the game, don’t forget to tell a friend or leave a review on Steam. Every bit of support helps us a ton.[/p][p]Follow us here on[url="https://store.steampowered.com/developer/neoclassicgames/"] Steam[/url] for news, giveaways and other cool events![/p][p][/p][p]<3, [/p][p]Anta & Neoclassic Games[/p]

notes.title: Pre-Odyssey: Demo 1.1 Update is Live! 🦆
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,

We’ve just updated the [i]Pre-Odyssey: Love at First Quack[/i] demo to [b]version 1.1[/b]! Here’s what’s new:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550499/020f230154fa19a06c8289e799f8483f2771a5d3.jpg[/img]
 
[list]
[*] Polished and refined scenes
[*] Fixed the error some players encountered on startup
[*] Voice Audio Fixes
[*] Optimized how the game launches on Steam for a smoother experience
[/list]

The full release is coming fast; [b]June 17[/b] is just around the corner!
If you’ve enjoyed the demo, please consider telling a friend and adding the game to your wishlist. It really helps!
